description: Example source-root layout. Each path is relative to ${SOURCE_ROOT}, which is set on each machine (AITUTOR_SOURCE_ROOT or --source-root). Folders that don't exist on your machine are simply reported as missing. To use your own layout, copy this file to AITUTOR_HOME/roots.json and edit it. Nothing here is read automatically.

roots.note: Your own licensed or open textbooks

parent_k12.how: Pass a district syllabus with `aitutor build --paste <file>` (or ingest_text() from Python)
parent_k12.optional_online: State DOE standards URL when network allowed
